mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (title, slug, description, content_md, tech_stack, status, category, github_url, demo_url, docs_url, cover_url, featured) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{contentMd}, #{techStack}, #{status}, #{category}, #{githubUrl}, #{demoUrl}, #{docsUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{featured})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET title=#{title}, slug=#{slug}, description=#{description}, content_md=#{contentMd}, tech_stack=#{techStack}, status=#{status}, category=#{category}, github_url=#{githubUrl}, demo_url=#{demoUrl}, docs_url=#{docsUrl}, cover_url=#{coverUrl}, featured=#{featured} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE project SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
